name: research-humanizer
description: Evidence-first research writing with English and Thai guidance. Preserve claims, check sources, and ask for missing study inputs.

interface.longDescription: Write and revise research papers without inventing results, citations, or missing study materials. Includes English and Thai guidance for prose, equations, figures, and submission checks.
defaultPrompt: Use research-paper-craft to revise this manuscript while preserving the evidence and asking for missing study inputs.
